all of them have been developed by me.”
Just as taught by the Buddha:
"I am one who attains at will the state of emptiness and the signless."
The Buddha’s own daughter is always delighted in Nibbāna;
all sensual desires have been utterly severed.
"Whatever [beings] are divine and whatever are human—
now there is no further existence."
… Another, the most excellent elder nun …
